name: Oceanside Fish Shop
notes: Router flagged wrong-branch (payload matched Rosecrans St branch); found the Oceanside-specific Toast ordering page linked from thefishshops.com/oceanside/, whose embedded address (236 S. Coast Hwy) matches the worklist. Dropped 'Featured Items' carousel section as duplicate of real fish-category items. Excluded one genuinely unpriced item ('Add A Bottle of FS Seasoning' under Retail, empty priceLine). 145 of 149 priced items filed.
